body:
## Scope

Add a complete authored proof-plus-audit edition for 30003087 / OWR-14222-015. The general conjecture remains **UNRESOLVED, 1/5 shared approaches used**, with the same history shared by broader targets 30003086 and 30004521.

For prime powers q≥4, the result proves the original source value over all fields for 0≤i≤q, i=2q−1, and i=q+1+a when the stated integer degree-excess criterion holds. This yields all stated bands through q=13. The first residual within these bands and this method is q=16,a=13,d=243; gaps outside the bands remain. This is not a claim that all d<243 are settled.

The literal q=2 endpoint expression is false and excluded. The q=2,3 cases and other already-known small values are credited to DHS. The finite-linear-space theorems are credited to EMSS, and no full independent audit of that paper or novelty claim is made.

## Contents and boundaries

Ten addition-only files contain the complete proof, complete independent mathematical review, scoped acceptance and status, provenance, research log, public-source ledger and identities, and an exact file manifest. All mathematical proof and audit sections are preserved. The required verification-wording correction was applied and identity-checked before nonmathematical editorial cleanup.

No source copies or source text, computational artifacts or their identities, private sources or coordination material are included. No queue change is part of this patch.

## Validation

- Original and wording-corrected proof identities verified before editing
- Complete proof through Section 7 and references, and complete mathematical audit sections, byte-preserved
- Three previously inspected public PDFs rehashed and matched to their recorded identities
- Exact allowlist, manifest identities, UTF-8/JSON and local links checked
- Addition-only patch and editorial diffs replayed cleanly with exact byte matches

These are local packaging checks, not hosted CI, human peer review, proof-assistant certification or a full resolution of the conjecture.
title: Add Harbourne bounded-partial proof and independent audit (30003087)
